source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 июля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Исавра диакона, Иннокентия , Филикса , Ермия , Василия , Перегрина , Руфа и Руфина Македонских (III-IV).»

attestations.note: The day’s sixth entry. This folder’s man is the sixth of the eight. A DIFFERENT DAY FROM THIS FOLDER’S OTHER ROWS, AND NO ROW IS MOVED. saint.gr and doxologia.ro keep the company of Apollonia on 17 June and this calendar keeps it on 6 июля ст. ст.; one attestation row per church is the schema, so the russian row stands on the russian day and the greek and romanian rows were left exactly as they are. THE RUSSIAN LINE NAMES EIGHT WHERE THE GREEK NAMES SIX. The reading life4167 was opened and is two sentences: «Святые мученики Исавр диакон, Иннокентий, Филикс, Ермий, Василий, Перегрин - афиняне, пострадавшие за Христа в македонском городе Аполлонии при императоре Нумериане (283-284). Вместе с ними были усечены уверовавшие во Христа два градоначальника - Руф и Руфин.» — Athenians who suffered at the Macedonian city of Apollonia under Numerian, and with them two city magistrates who had come to believe, Rufus and Rufinus. Those two are new folders in this batch, `rufus-of-apollonia` and `rufinus-of-apollonia`, and the whole company is joined by `related`. `dates` UNCHANGED, and nothing is owed: the reign this reading names, «Нумериане (283-284)», is the same reign and the same interval saint.gr gave, so the two books agree; the line’s own «(III-IV)» is wider than either and narrows nothing. `types` UNCHANGED. No hymn on the day page stands under any of these eight names, and azbyka.ru was not read. Name page 1761 heads him «Перегрин Афинянин, Аполлониадский (Македонский), мч.» or with the rank the line gives, and lists «День памяти: 6 июля» and no other day.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 17 iunie — «Sfântul Mucenic Peregrin»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ίσαυρος και οι συν αυτώ Βασίλειος, Ιννοκέντιος, Ερμείας, Φιλήκας και Περεγρίνος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It is plainly the same martyr, of the company beheaded at Apollonia under the eparch Tripontius, whom the folder's Romanian row already keeps on 17 June. saint.gr's entry names six where doxologia's line gave four: it adds Basil, whom doxologia does not name at all, and gives Hermias a place in the heading. The page dates the contest by the reign of Numerian, 283–284, and gives no year of death. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Mucenicii Tăi, Doamne, întru nevoinţele lor, cununile nesctricăciunii au dobândit de la Tine, Dumnezeul nostru. Că având tăria Ta, pe chinuitori au învins; zdrobit-au şi ale demonilor neputincioase îndrăzniri. Pentru rugăciunile lor, mântuieşte sufletele noastre, Hristoase Dumnezeule.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfinților Mucenici Isavru, Inochentie, Felix, Peregrin și celor împreună cu dânșii. It is the common troparion of martyrs, printed for the whole company and naming none of them; the reading «nesctricăciunii» is the page's own spelling.

english.text: Thy martyrs, O Lord, in their contest received from Thee, our God, the crowns of incorruption; for having Thy strength, they overthrew the tormentors and broke also the feeble insolence of the demons. At their prayers, O Christ God, save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἐννεάριθμον, τοῦ Λόγου σύνταγμα, ἐχθρῶν τὰς φάλαγγας, κατετροπώσαντο, Ἰσαυρος Φήλιξ σὺν αὐτοῖς, Ἐρμείας καὶ Περεγρῖνος, ἅμα Ἰννοκέντιος, Μανουὴλ καὶ Βασίλειος, Ἰσμαὴλ ὁ ἔνδοξος, καὶ Σαβὲλ ὁ μακάριος· διὸ καὶ τὰ βραβεῖα τῆς νίκης, εὗρον ὡς Μάρτυρες Κυρίου.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), ᾌχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — printed on the page of «Άγιος Ίσαυρος» and again on that of the three Persians; a service of nine which names all six of Apollonia and all three brothers

english.text: As a nine-numbered company of the Word they routed the phalanxes of the enemy — Isaurus, Felix with them, Hermias and Peregrinus, together with Innocent, Manuel and Basil, Ismael the glorious and Sabel the blessed; and therefore they found the prizes of victory as martyrs of the Lord.
